gyeongpo-beach.name: Gangneung Gyeongpo Beach
gyeongpo-beach.desc: Located 1 kilometer away from Gyeongpodae Pavilion and 6 kilometers from downtown Gangneung, Gyeongpo Beach is a sand bank formed between Gyeongpoho Lake and the ocean.

gangmun-beach.name: Gangmun Beach
gangmun-beach.desc: Located in Gangmun-dong, Gangmun Beach is lined with fresh hoe (sliced raw fish) restaurants along Gangmunhang Port.

anmok-beach.name: Anmokhaebyeon Beach
anmok-beach.desc: Anmokhaebyeon Beach spans over 500 meters in length and covers an area of 20,000 square meters.

sacheon-beach.name: Sacheon Beach
sacheon-beach.desc: Nestled between Gyeongpodae Beach and Yeongok Beach, Sacheon Beach is a clean and quiet beach covering an area of 18,000 ㎡ over a length of 300 meters.

yeongjin-beach.name: Yeongjin Beach
yeongjin-beach.desc: Yeongjinhaebyeon Beach is a quiet and clean beach filled with the blue hue of the sea, making it a popular attraction among the locals.

hyangho-beach.name: Hyanghohaebyeon Beach
hyangho-beach.desc: Hyanghohaebyeon Beach is a white sandy beach backed by pine forest complete with a campground.

jeongdongjin.name: Jeongdongjinhaebyeon Beach
jeongdongjin.desc: Jeongdongjinhaebyeon Beach is a nice, sandy beach with three major swimming spots: in front of Jeongdongjin Station, by Sandglass Park, and by the Jeongdongjin Breakwater.

jjamppong-tofu.name: Gangneung Jjamppong Sundubu Donghwa Garden
jjamppong-tofu.desc: This restaurant was the first to start selling jjamppong sundubu (spicy seafood and soft bean curd soup) in Chodang Dubu Village.

ojukheon.name: Ojukheon House & Municipal Museum
ojukheon.desc: Ojukheon House, a Treasure, is an important house which shows the lifestyle and architectual style of the early Joseon dynasty.

seongyojang.name: Seongyojang House
seongyojang.desc: Seongyojang House is the former upper class residence of Lee Nae-beon (1703-1781) and his family in Gangneung, Gangwon State.

gyeongpodae.name: Gyeongpodae Pavilion
gyeongpodae.desc: Gyeongpodae Pavilion, located on a small hill north of Gyeongpoho Lake, is one of the eight scenic sites of Gwangdong (northeastern coast).

heo-park.name: Heo Gyun and Heo Nanseolheon Memorial Park

arte.name: ARTE Museum Valley Gangneung
arte.desc: ARTE Museum Valley Gangneung, located by Gyeongpo Lake, is the third immersive media art exhibition presented by d'strict, a digital media design company.

haslla.name: Haslla Art World
haslla.desc: Haslla Art World is an art space that harmonizes nature, people and art.

time-museum.name: Jeongdongjin Time Museum
time-museum.desc: Jeongdongjin Time Museum is comprised of a steam locomotive and 180-meter-long train at the famous Sandglass Park.

gyeongpo-lake.name: Gyeongpoho Lake
gyeongpo-lake.desc: Gyeongpoho Lake is a popular attraction, with beautiful natural scenery and many cultural relics nearby.

solhyang.name: Gangneung Solhyang Arboretum
solhyang.desc: Gangneung Solhyang Arboretum was built in 2008 and opened on October 30, 2013 in Gujeong-ri, Gujeong-myeon.

chuam.name: Chuam Chotdaebawi Rock
chuam.desc: Chuam Chotdaebawi Rock in Donghae-si, Gangwon-do is one of Korea’s most famous tourist attractions.

nongoldam.name: Donghae Nongoldam-gil Street (Deungdae Damhwa Village)
nongoldam.desc: Nongoldam-gil Street, formed in 1941, was transformed in 2010 with the "Nongoldam-gil Street" project by the Donghae Culture Center.

dojjaebi.name: Dojjaebigol Sky Valley
dojjaebi.desc: Dojjaebigol Sky Valley, located between Mukho Lighthouse and Wolsotaekji, provides a beautiful view of East Sea with various activities.

mangsang.name: Mangsanghaebyeon Beach
mangsang.desc: Mangsang Beach is sought out by many families and tourists for its beautiful white sand, lush pine forest, shallow waters, and location in a neighborhood full of convenient facilities.

hwanseon.name: Hwanseongul Cave (Daei-ri Cave System)
hwanseon.desc: Hwanseongul Cave is the largest limestone cave in Asia, formed estimated 530 million years ago.

sokcho-beach.name: Sokcho Beach
sokcho-beach.desc: Sokcho Beach opened in 1976 and is one of Korea's representative beaches.

yeonggeumjeong.name: Yeonggeumjeong
yeonggeumjeong.desc: Yeonggeumjeong refers to the area covering the shore by the Sokcho Lighthouse in Sokcho-si City.

abai.name: Abai Village Ferry
abai.desc: Gaetbae (boat without engine) is an exotic means of transportation to cross the Abai Village at the mouth of Cheongchoho Lake.

cheongcho.name: Cheongchoho Lake Park
cheongcho.desc: Cheongchoho Lake Park is where the 1999 International Tourism & Culture Expo was held.

seorak-cable.name: Seoraksan Cable Car
seorak-cable.desc: A ride on the Seoraksan Cable Car is the best way to enjoy the unexplored regions of Seoraksan Mountain.

hwajinpo.name: Hwajinpo Lake
hwajinpo.desc: Hwajinpo Lake is one of the most famous lagoons in Korea.

naksan-beach.name: Naksan Beach
naksan-beach.desc: Naksan Beach is one of the most famous beaches in Yangyang, located in Joseon-ri, Yangyang-eup, Yangyang-gun, Gangwon-do.

surfyy.name: Yangyang Surfyy Beach
surfyy.desc: Surfyy Beach is a 1 kilometer-long beach designated for surfing, just north of Hajodae Beach in Yangyang.

hajodae.name: Hajodae Scenic Point
hajodae.desc: The rocky coastline along Hyeonbuk-myeon in Yangyang called Hajodae is one of the Eight Sights of Yangyang.

birch.name: Wondae-ri Birch Forest (Whispering Birch Forest)
birch.desc: Wondae-ri Birch Forest near Inje-eup is an exemplar of natural eco-tourism, established by planting 690,000 birch trees across 138 hectares from 1974 to 1995.

daepo.name: Daepohang Port
daepo.desc: Located on the southernmost point of Sokcho, Daephohang Port is known as a place to find quality fish with the rise of Seoraksan Mountain as a popular tourist destination.

yangyang-market.name: Yangyang Traditional Market
yangyang-market.desc: Geographically situated where Seoraksan Mountain and Odaesan Mountain meet, Yangyang is rich in local specialties due to its unique soil and climate characteristics.

kimyoujeong.name: The Literary Village of Kim You Jeong

soyang-skywalk.name: Soyanggang Skywalk
soyang-skywalk.desc: The Soyanggang Skywalk, extending over the river, spans 174 meters in length, with a transparent glass floor covering 156 meters of its section.

cc-museum.name: Chuncheon National Museum
cc-museum.desc: Opened in 2002, Chuncheon National Museum was established to identify and promote the original form and characteristics of the regional culture of Gangwon State.

gongjicheon.name: Gongjicheon Recreation Area
gongjicheon.desc: The area of Gongjicheon Stream connected to the Bukhangang River is a shelter in the middle of Chuncheon City.

hantan-trail.name: Hantangang River Jusangjeolli-gil
hantan-trail.desc: This 3.6-km trail in the Hantangang River UNESCO Global Geopark is filled with awe-inspiring cliffs and various size rocks.

hwacheon-river.name: Bungeoseom Island
hwacheon-river.desc: Bungeoseom Island was created as a result of the construction of the Chuncheon Dam.

samak-cable.name: Chuncheon Samaksan Mountain Lake Cable Car
samak-cable.desc: Samaksan Mountain Lake Cable Car is the longest cable car in Korea, which connects Samcheon-dong and Samaksan Mountain across Uiamho Lake.

labor-party.name: Cheorwon Korean Workers' Party Headquarters
labor-party.desc: This three-story building located in Cheorwon-eup was constructed in 1946.

jiktang.name: Jiktangpokpo Falls [National Geopark]
jiktang.desc: Jiktangpokpo Falls is location in the middle of Hantangang River.

sheep.name: Daegwallyeong Yangtte Ranch
sheep.desc: Daegwallyeong Yangtte Ranch is situated at an elevation of 920 meters, sprawling across 205,000 square meters of open grassland.

balwang.name: Balwangsan Cable Car
balwang.desc: Equipped with 100 eight-passenger cabins, Balwangsan Cable Car is a 7.4-kilometer-long cable car that ensures a swift and safe ride.

woljeongsa.name: Woljeongsa Temple & Needle Fir Forest
woljeongsa.desc: Woljeongsa Temple, established in 643 during the Silla dynasty, is located on Odaesan Mountain.

samtan.name: Samtan Art Mine
samtan.desc: Samtan Art Mine is an art complex transformed from an abandoned mine.

hanbando.name: Korean Peninsula Terrain [National Geopark]
hanbando.desc: Korean Peninsula Terrain was formed by soil transported from upstream to the curvature of the confluence of two rivers.

hwangji.name: Hwangji Pond
hwangji.desc: Hwangji Pond, located in downtown Taebaek, is a source of the Nakdonggang River, flowing all the way to the Yeongnam Plain.

sogeumsan.name: Sogeumsan Mountain Grand Valley
sogeumsan.desc: Home to beautiful rivers, majestic cliffs, and stunning old trees, Sogeum Mountain Grand Valley offers an impressive view.

bangyeri.name: Wonju Bangye-ri Ginkgo Tree
bangyeri.desc: Although the exact age of the Bankye-ri Ginkgo Tree is unknown, it is estimated to be over 800 years old.

guryongsa.name: Guryongsa Temple
guryongsa.desc: Guryongsa Temple is located 6 kilometers from Birobong Peak on Chiaksan Mountain, in the direction of Hakkok-ri.

wj-market.name: Wonju Jungang Market
wj-market.desc: Opened in the 1950s as a five-day market, Wonju Jungang Market is now a permanently operated market.

f-trout.name: Pyeongchang Trout Festival
f-trout.desc: Details for the 2027 festivals will be updated as they become available.*In the past, winters in this region were unforgiving.
